name: cnv_consensus_pipeline
description: Copy number variant detection using cn_farms (FARMS algorithm on Affymetrix CEL files / aligned BAM) for primary segmentation, then CNVRanger for CNV-expression / phenotype association across the called regions. Members of a 19-member aCGH+CNV alternative-substitution cluster (adacgh2, biohmm, cghseg, cn.farms, crlmm) are interchangeable at step 2 depending on input array platform.
example_queries: copy number variant detection and phenotype association
CNV calling with cn.farms then association testing
copy number expression eQTL via CNVRanger
